content:
Tomorrow it's live.  So excited!
Thirty years. Hollywood sets, enterprise boardrooms, one $5M meeting...
all of it in one book, and for launch week, now, it costs less than the coffee in your hand.

Why Buyers Say No goes live tomorrow on Kindle,
with the tools built in: the No Score quiz, DealScrolling, the 100 Reasons swipe file.

You aren't losing to competition. You're losing to confusion. The book shows you exactly where, and what to say instead.

Want a head start tonight? The free field guide is the first four days of the book, five worksheets, and one formula you'll use before lunch tomorrow. 48 pages. Link in the first comment.

Tomorrow morning I post the Kindle link. Comment BOOK and I'll DM it to you the minute it's live.

$2.99 is the lowest this will ever be. I'd rather you read it than pay for it.

#BookLaunch #B2BSales #Storytelling #WhyBuyersSayNo
